Acetylene Dream#

slangloyaltyelfcorporatecontractharborshelfspireold harbor
term Acetylene Dream
definition The delusional belief, common among Tier 2 workers, that one spectacular act of loyalty or risk-taking will catapult them permanently into Tier 1 or Spire-level security. Named for the brief, brilliant flame that burns out quickly.
origin Shelf and Old Harbor street cant, evolved from industrial metaphor
usage Used mockingly by Tier 3 and below to describe someone chasing an impossible corporate windfall
tier Tier 2-3
category slang
example "He took that Axiom enforcement contract for half pay — pure acetylene dream, watch him get dropped the second the job's done."

Acid Alley#

geographicelfharboralleyshelfold harbor
term Acid Alley
definition Any corridor where industrial runoff makes the air dangerous to breathe without filtration
origin Shelf Cant — from the acidic chemical residue
usage Shelf, Old Harbor
tier Tier 1
category geographic
example Do not take Acid Alley without a respirator.

Ambush Bridge#

infrastructureaugmentelfshelf
term Ambush Bridge
definition A fake troll bridge set up to rob people rather than collect tolls — no rules observed
origin Shelf Cant — from the predatory variation of troll bridges
usage street-level
tier Tier 1
category infrastructure
example That is an ambush bridge. They will take your quanta and your augments.

Ambush Corridor#

combatelfalleyshelf
term Ambush Corridor
definition A narrow passage ideal for surprise attacks — the Shelf is full of them
origin Shelf Cant — military terminology applied to Shelf architecture
usage Shelf, tactical
tier Tier 1-2
category combat
example The alley between Level 2 and 3 is a known ambush corridor.

Analog#

tech termscircuit
term Analog
definition Anything non-digital — old-technology, handwritten, or in-person transactions
origin Circuit Slang — from the analog/digital divide
usage universal
tier Tier 1-3
category tech terms
example Keep it analog. No screens, no signals, no records.

Analog Gap#

surveillancecircuit
term Analog Gap
definition The assumption that physical communication avoids surveillance — increasingly false
origin Circuit Slang — from security research on surveillance countermeasures
usage Circuit, operational
tier Tier 1-3
category surveillance
example The analog gap is dead. LexScan killed it.

Analog Trade#

economicelfquantaharborshelfold harbor
term Analog Trade
definition Barter economy that operates outside the Quanta system — exchanging physical goods, services, and favors with no digital trail
origin Shelf Cant — the old way of trading, revived by people the digital economy forgot
usage street-level
tier Tier 1
category economic
example Old Harbor runs on analog trade. Fish for medicine. Repair work for roof space. No wallets needed.

Anchor#

socialharbor
term Anchor
definition A person who keeps you grounded and sane — your primary emotional connection
origin Harbor Patois — nautical metaphor for emotional stability
usage intimate, personal
tier Tier 1-3
category social
example Mrs. Chen is Kyle's anchor.

Anchor Baby#

socialelfcorporateshelf
term Anchor Baby
definition A child born in corporate territory specifically to gain tier status for the family
origin Shelf Cant — adapted from the pre-Meridian immigration term
usage Shelf, social
tier Tier 1-2
category social
example They spent everything for an anchor baby in Tessera territory.

Anchor Down#

street slangharbornightold harbor
term Anchor Down
definition Harbor greeting meaning I am settled, I am safe, come talk to me
origin Harbor Patois — from nautical anchoring terminology
usage Old Harbor
tier Tier 1
category street slang
example Anchor down at Maren’s place tonight if you need to talk business.

Anchor Drop#

corporateidentityfood
term Anchor Drop
definition The sudden and total severing of a person's financial accounts, social credit, and Diaspora identity by a corponation — effectively making them invisible to legitimate society. Distinguished from being 'Zeroed' in that the target still physically exists but cannot transact, travel through tolled corridors, or access tiered services.
origin Corporate legal jargon repurposed as street cant, referencing the act of 'dropping anchor' on a moving asset
usage Used by fixer networks and street lawyers; also muttered as a threat by mid-management in corponation settings
tier All Tiers
category corporate
example She crossed Sterling-Nakamura on a Tuesday and by Friday they hit her with an anchor drop — couldn't even buy tube food without a ghost account.

Anchor Line#

crimeharbor
term Anchor Line
definition A reliable, established smuggling route operating safely for years
origin Harbor Patois — from the nautical term for a stable mooring line
usage smuggling
tier Tier 1-2
category crime
example The Bilge Covenant's anchor line has not been compromised in eight years.

Anchor Point#

infrastructureelfshelf
term Anchor Point
definition One of the Shelf's structural connections to the sea wall — the most stable and valuable locations
origin Shelf Cant — from the engineering term for attachment points
usage Shelf
tier Tier 1
category infrastructure
example Mrs. Chen's is near an anchor point. That is why it still stands.

Apex Severance#

corporateidentityneuralmedicalrightsspire
term Apex Severance
definition A Spire-level executive termination package so lavish it effectively functions as a second fortune — including full neural archive rights, offshore asset transfers, identity reseeding, and lifetime medical coverage — ensuring that even fired Tier 1 executives never face real consequences.
origin Corporate HR jargon, Palladian Group compensation architecture
usage Used bitterly by lower tiers and labor advocates; discussed matter-of-factly in Spire business culture
tier Tier 1
category corporate
example "They 'let him go' after the Meridian data breach scandal — but with apex severance, he was sipping real coffee in a Geneva arcology inside a week."

Arc Welder#

combataugmentelfpowershelf
term Arc Welder
definition A heavy-hitting augmented fighter relying on brute force over finesse
origin Shelf Cant — from the industrial tool applied to people who fight like machinery
usage combat
tier Tier 1-2
category combat
example The arc welder was all power, no precision. Kyle took him apart.

Arcturus Etiquette#

combatviolencegangcorporatecontract
term Arcturus Etiquette
definition The unwritten rules governing violence in contested commercial or neutral zones — specifically the expectation of minimal collateral, no civilian witnesses, and clean disposal, as enforced de facto by Arcturus Defense Solutions contractors who maintain corridor security contracts. Violating it draws professional consequences regardless of faction.
origin Combat slang, attributed to the operational culture of Arcturus Defense Solutions' corridor enforcement divisions
usage Mercenaries, runners, gang leadership, and corporate security across the corridor; widely understood even by those who resent it
tier Tier 2-4
category combat
example They could have hit the target at the transit hub, but that wasn't Arcturus etiquette — they waited until he crossed into the industrial block.

Ash Covenant#

underworldbetrayalelfcorporateshelf
term Ash Covenant
definition An unwritten agreement between Shelf-dwellers that survivors of a corponation raid will not report each other to Ferrogate Security or corporate liaisons. Violation is considered the deepest betrayal in Tier 1 communities.
origin Street cant, derived from the practice of burning evidence and making oaths over the ash
usage Tier 1 communities, particularly in the Gulch and Wet Below; rarely understood by outsiders
tier Tier 1
category underworld
example She gave up Marro's name to the Ferrogate sweepers — broke Ash Covenant, and the whole block turned on her by morning.

AtmoSync#

tech termselfcontrolshelfspire
term AtmoSync
definition Atmospheric management system controlling Meridian's weather and air quality — tiered by altitude
origin Spire Speak — Axiom Industries brand name for climate control
usage universal
tier Tier 1-5
category tech terms
example AtmoSync keeps the Core at 72 degrees. The Shelf gets whatever leaks through.

Augment Addiction#

medicalaugmentcircuit
term Augment Addiction
definition Psychological compulsion to keep upgrading — where enough is never enough
origin Circuit Slang — from the addictive quality of performance enhancement
usage Circuit, medical
tier Tier 1-3
category medical
example Augment addiction took everything from him.

Augment Art#

culturalaugmentprostheticcircuit

definition Body art created by modifying augmentations for aesthetic purposes — chrome as canvas
origin Circuit Slang — from creative modification of functional hardware
usage Circuit, cultural
tier Tier 1-3
category cultural
example His augment art turns his prosthetic arm into a light show.

medicalaugmentcontrolnightalcoholcircuit

definition The morning-after effect of overclocking — headache, nausea, motor control issues
origin Circuit Slang — comparing augment abuse to alcohol abuse
usage Circuit, augmented
tier Tier 1-3
category medical
example He has an augment hangover from redlining last night.

Augmented Edge#

combatweaponbladeaugmentelfshelf

definition Kyle's katana — a traditional blade enhanced with vibration technology that cuts reinforced materials
origin Shelf Cant — from the augmentation of the weapon's cutting edge
usage specific to Kyle
tier Tier 1-2
category combat
example The augmented edge hummed as he drew it.

aisyntheticconsciousnesssyntheticelfcircuit

example Is that AI awakened or just really good at pretending?

street slangelfshelf

example Axiom’s ass, did you see the price of synth-protein this week?

usage Shelf, Circuit
tier Tier 1-2
category medical
example The back-alley install went wrong. His optic nerve is damaged.

tech termscircuit

definition Corrupted data flowing back into a hacker's system during an intrusion — digital blowback
origin Circuit Slang — from reverse data flow
usage Circuit, hacker
tier Tier 1-3
category tech terms
example Got backwash from the Tessera intrusion. My rig is contaminated.

category street slang
example I am out of bandwidth. Three jobs, a favor debt, and the Lotus wants a meeting.

category surveillance
example Your behavioral signature is more identifying than your face.

usage Old Harbor, smuggling

category crime
example She needs a bilge run to get out of the city. Talk to the Covenant.

Black Clinic#
